items.title: Enable cross-Region fine-grained data access with AWS Lake Formation and Trusted Identity Propagation
items.summary: Trusted Identity Propagation with AWS IAM Identity Center now works across Regions. Learn how to share AWS Lake Formation-governed Amazon S3 and Amazon Redshift data in one Region and query it from another as the actual corporate user, with fine-grained access control and per-user auditability in AWS CloudTrail.
items.creator: Maneesh Sharma
